in_urdu.name: رمضان
in_urdu.meaning: ہر سال کا عسکری ماه، محبت و سکون کی علامت، بہترین ماه، بھلائی اور نیکیوں کا ماه
in_urdu.long_meaning: رمضان شوال کا دوسرا ماه ہے جو کہ ہمیشہ کا عسکری ماه ہے، محبت اور سکون کی علامت ہے۔ یہ بہترین ماه ہے، بھلائی اور نیکیوں کا ماه ہے۔ یہ ماه مسلمانوں کے لیے ایک بہترین موقع ہے، جہاں وہ اپنے اعمال کو سچا اور درست بناتے ہیں۔ یہ ماه مسلمانوں کے لیے ایک بہترین موقع ہے، جہاں وہ اپنے اعمال کو سچا اور درست بناتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रमज़ान
in_hindi.meaning: हजारों वर्षों से साहस का प्रतीक, दया और शांति का प्रतीक, सबसे अच्छा महीना, भलाई और अच्छाई का महीना
in_hindi.long_meaning: रमज़ान शवाल का दूसरा महीना है, जो हजारों वर्षों से साहस का प्रतीक है, दया और शांति का प्रतीक है। यह सबसे अच्छा महीना है, भलाई और अच्छाई का महीना है। यह महीना मुसलमानों के लिए एक शानदार अवसर है, जहां वे अपने कार्यों को सच्चा और सही बनाते हैं।

in_pashto.name: رمضان
in_pashto.meaning: ډیری کلونه د ګټې دې ماه، د محبت او سکون ښکار، تر ټولو ښه ماه، د ښه کارونو ماه
in_pashto.long_meaning: رمضان شوال د دوهم ماه دی، دا ډیری کلونه د ګټې دې ماه دی، د محبت او سکون ښکار دی۔ دا تر ټولو ښه ماه دی، د ښه کارونو ماه دی۔ دا په افغانستان کې د مسلمانو لپاره دوه ګونی ماه دی، کوم چې دوی د خپلو ګټو پر عاید کوي.

in_english.name: Ramadhan
in_english.meaning: Sacred month of fasting, a symbol of self-control and compassion, a time for spiritual growth and renewal, a month of blessings and mercy
in_english.long_meaning: Ramadhan is the ninth month of the Islamic calendar and is considered a sacred month of fasting. It is a symbol of self-control and compassion, a time for spiritual growth and renewal. During this month, Muslims fast from dawn to sunset, abstaining from food and drink, and engage in prayer and charity. It is a time for spiritual reflection, self-improvement, and increased devotion to Allah. Ramadhan is a month of blessings and mercy, where Allah forgives the sins of believers and grants them spiritual rejuvenation.

data.cultural_impact: Ramadhan is a period of intense spiritual reflection, discipline and commemoration of God's mercy. It is a time when Muslims strengthen their bond with Allah through daily prayer, reading the Quran, giving to charity and practicing self-control. This month is also an opportunity for Muslims to deepen their connection with their communities and to extend kindness and generosity to others.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of Ramadhan lies in the act of fasting, which serves as a reminder of the suffering of the less fortunate and the importance of empathy and compassion. This practice also encourages self-discipline and self-control, helping individuals to develop a deeper connection with God and to cultivate virtuous habits. Fasting during Ramadhan is believed to purify the soul, improve one's character, and increase spiritual evolution. In the Quran, it is stated that "O you who believe! Fasting is prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you, that you may learn self-restraint" (2:183). By following this divine instruction, Muslims seek to purify their hearts and souls in preparation for the balance of their eternal life in the hereafter.
